Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(janitor)
```
Read in TDO1 data for data with only one rep per trial
```{r,read in TDO1 1-rep data}
TDO1Climb1 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDOClimbingTrial1.csv")#11am on 7/6/23 (1-2 days)
TDO1Climb2 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDOClimbingTrial2.csv")#11am on 7/7/23 (2-3 days)
TDO1Climb3 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDOClimbingTrial3.csv")#3pm on 7/7/23 (2-3 days)
TDO1Climb4 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDOClimbingTrial4.csv")#11am on 7/10/23 (4-6 days)
TDO1Climb <- rbind(TDO1Climb1,TDO1Climb2,TDO1Climb3,TDO1Climb4)#appending these data together
rm(TDO1Climb1,TDO1Climb2,TDO1Climb3,TDO1Climb4)#removing extraneous files from environment
TDO1Climb1ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/lilyday0_individual_slopes.csv")#11am on 7/6/23 (1-2 days)
TDO1Climb1ind$trial<-1
TDO1Climb2ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/lilyday1_individual_slopes.csv")#11am on 7/7/23 (2-3 days)
TDO1Climb2ind$trial<-2
TDO1Climb3ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/lilyday1_5_individual_slopes.csv")#3pm on 7/7/23 (2-3 days)
TDO1Climb3ind$trial<-3
TDO1Climb4ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/lilyday2_individual_slopes.csv")#11am on 7/10/23 (4-6 days)
TDO1Climb4ind$trial<-4
TDO1Climbind <- rbind(TDO1Climb1ind,TDO1Climb2ind,TDO1Climb3ind,TDO1Climb4ind)#appending these data together
rm(TDO1Climb1ind,TDO1Climb2ind,TDO1Climb3ind,TDO1Climb4ind)#removing extraneous files from environment
```
Read in TDO1 data with 3 reps per trial
```{r,read in TDO1 3-rep data}
TDO1Climb5 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDOClimbingTrial5.csv")#10am on 7/28/23 (23 days)
#TDO1Climb6 <- read.csv("data/TDO1/NAMEOFNEWDATAHERE.csv")#11am on 8/10/23 (37 days) #this is where new data goes
TDO1Climb5ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/do1_individual_slopes.csv")#10am on 7/28/23 (23 days)
TDO1Climb5ind$trial<-5
#TDO1Climb6ind <- read.csv("data/TDO1/NAMEOFNEWDATAHERE.csv")#11am on 8/10/23 (37 days) #this is where new data goes
```
Adding a "rep" column for the 1-rep data, and creating a single dataframe for group and individual data
```{r}
TDO1Climb$rep<-"1" #adding the column for rep so that later when we combine with Climb5, we will have all the same columns
TDO1Climb <- rbind(TDO1Climb,TDO1Climb5)#now all of the data is combined (Here is where you would add Climb6 group data) 
TDO1Climbind$rep<-"1"

```

```{r,read in TDO1 individual data}
TDO1Climb5ind<-clean_names(TDO1Climb5ind)

TDO1Climb5ind2<-TDO1Climb5
TDO1Climb5ind2$slope<-NULL
TDO1Climb5ind<-merge(TDO1Climb5ind,TDO1Climb5ind2,by=c("vial_ID","batch"))

TDO1Climbind<-clean_names(TDO1Climbind)
TDO1Climb5ind<-TDO1Climb5ind%>%select("day","name","vial_id","pos","batch","slope","start_frame","end_frame","rsquare","trial","rep")
TDO1Climbind <- rbind(TDO1Climbind,TDO1Climb5ind)
TDO1_Key<-TDO1Climb%>%select("vial_id","sex","n","color","treatment","group")
TDO1Climbind<-merge(TDO1_Key,TDO1Climbind,by="vial_id")
TDO1Climbind<-distinct(TDO1Climbind)
rm(TDO1Climb1,TDO1Climb2,TDO1Climb3,TDO1Climb4,TDO1Climb5,TDO1Climb5ind, TDO1Climb5ind2)
```



```{r}
#Climb1-4 did NOT have three replicates, but Climb5 DID have three replicates. Here we are manipulating the data so that a column for "rep" is added onto the first data


TDO1Climb<-TDO1Climb%>%select("vial_ID","Sex","N","Color","Treatment","group","batch","slope","r_value","std_err","Trial","rep")
rm(list = c("TDO1Climb1","TDO1Climb2","TDO1Climb3","TDO1Climb4"))
TDO1Climb<-clean_names(TDO1Climb)
```

TDO2 data
```{r}
TDO2_key<-read.csv("data/TDO2/TDO2_Lifespan.csv")
TDO2_key<-TDO2_key%>%select("vial_ID","color","treatment","TDOconc","DMSO.","sex")
TDO2Climb1<-read.csv("data/TDO2/do2_slopes_concatenated.csv")#10am on 7/28/23 (4-6 days)
TDO2Climb<-merge(TDO2Climb1,TDO2_key,by=c("vial_ID"))
TDO2Climbind<-TDO2Climb1
TDO2Climbind$slope<-NULL
TDO2Climbind$batch<-NULL
TDO2Climbind2<-read.csv("data/TDO2/do2_individual_slopes.csv")#10am on 7/28/23 (4-6 days)
TDO2Climbind<-merge(TDO2Climbind,TDO2Climbind2,by="vial_ID")  
TDO2Climbind<-distinct(TDO2Climbind)
TDO2Climbind<-merge(TDO2Climbind,TDO2_key,by=c("vial_ID"))
TDO2Climbind<-clean_names(TDO2Climbind)
TDO2Climb<-clean_names(TDO2Climb)
TDO2Climb<-TDO2Climb%>%select("vial_id","sex","color","treatment","td_oconc","batch","slope","r_value","std_err","rep")
rm(TDO2Climb1,TDO2Climbind2)

TDO2Climbind<-TDO2Climbind%>%select("vial_id","sex","color","treatment","td_oconc","batch","slope","r_value","std_err","rep")
TDO2Climbind<-distinct(TDO2Climbind)
```

Did repeating any vials have an absolute effect?
```{r}
Repeats %>% 
  group_by(ClimbVial, rep, Trial) %>% 
  summarise(Slopes = mean(slope), Intercepts = mean(intercept),Trial=Trial) -> Repeats2
Repeats2$ClimbVial<-as.factor(Repeats2$ClimbVial)
Repeats2$rep<-as.factor(Repeats2$rep)
Repeats2$Trial<-as.factor(Repeats2$Trial)

Repeats2 %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = interaction(rep,ClimbVial), y = Slopes, color = rep) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(ClimbVial,Trial))) +
  geom_point()

Repeats2 %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = interaction(rep,ClimbVial), y = Intercepts, color = rep) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(ClimbVial,Trial))) +
  geom_point()

ggboxplot(Repeats%>%filter(rep=="1"), x = "ClimbVial", y = "slope",
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Climbing Slope for Repeat Climbers - First Trial")

ggboxplot(Repeats%>%filter(rep=="2"), x = "ClimbVial", y = "slope",
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Climbing Slope for Repeat Climbers - Second Trial")

ggboxplot(Repeats%>%filter(rep=="1"), x = "ClimbVial", y = "intercept",
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Climbing Intercept for Repeat Climbers - First Trial")

ggboxplot(Repeats%>%filter(rep=="2"), x = "ClimbVial", y = "intercept",
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Climbing Intercept for Repeat Climbers - Second Trial")

```


Compute means
```{r}
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID,Trial) %>%
  summarise(
    sex = sex,
    Trial=Trial,
    batch = batch,
    group=group,
    treatment = treatment,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_Mean
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID,Trial,rep) %>%
  summarise(
    sex = sex,
    Trial=Trial,
    group=group,
    treatment = treatment,
    rep=rep,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_Mean2
Climb%>%group_by(vial_ID,rep) %>%
  summarise(
    sex = sex,
    group=group,
    treatment = treatment,
    Color = Color,
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    intercept = mean(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))->Climb_MeanTrial
Climb_Mean<-distinct(Climb_Mean)
Climb_Mean2<-distinct(Climb_Mean2)
Climb_MeanTrial<-distinct(Climb_MeanTrial)

Climb_Mean$group<-factor(Climb_Mean$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
Climb_Mean2$group<-factor(Climb_Mean2$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
Climb_MeanTrial$group<-factor(Climb_MeanTrial$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5 mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
TDO2Climb1$color<-factor(TDO2Climb1$color, levels=c('Red1', 'Red2', 'Red3','Blue2','Blue3))

DMSO<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO")
TDOlow<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="1")
TDOmid<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="2")
TDOhigh<-Climb_Mean%>%filter(group=="3")

```


```{r}
p <- ggboxplot(Climb_Mean, x = "Color", y = "slope",
          color = "Color", #palette = c("black", "red"),
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Slope by treatment")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()

p <- ggboxplot(Climb_Mean, x = "Color", y = "intercept",
          color = "Color", #palette = c("black", "red"),
          add = "jitter")+
  ggtitle("Intercept by treatment")
#  Add p-value
p + stat_compare_means()
```

ANOVAS
```{r}
Climb_Mean$Trial<-as.factor(Climb_Mean$Trial)
Climb_Mean$treatment<-as.factor(Climb_Mean$treatment)
Climb_Mean$sex<-as.factor(Climb_Mean$sex)

Climb_Mean2%>%filter(sex=="M")->Climb_MeanM
Climb_Mean2%>%filter(sex=="F")->Climb_MeanF

summary(aov(slope ~ treatment*Trial, data = Climb_MeanM%>%filter(group=="TDO 10mM")))
summary(aov(slope ~ treatment*Trial, data = Climb_MeanF%>%filter(group=="TDO 10mM")))
```
Calculate sample size needed to detect significant effect in 10mM Females
```{r}
Climb%>%filter(sex=="F"&group=="TDO 10mM"&treatment=="DMSO")->effectsDMSO
Climb%>%filter(sex=="F"&group=="TDO 10mM"&treatment=="TDO")->effectsTDO

library(lsr)
cohensD(effectsDMSO$slope,effectsTDO$slope)

library(pwr)
pwr.t.test(n=4, d=.48 , sig.level = .05, power = , type = c("two.sample"))
pwr.t.test(n=, d=.48 , sig.level = .05, power = .8, type = c("two.sample"))

```
